mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 82 degrees, though the air quality index is currently elevated at 58.

Construction alert for the intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive, which will be closed for water main connections from August 5 to August 7. Also, voting is now open for the student I Voted sticker design contest through August 7.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today includes the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, enjoy Concerts in the Park and trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing.
In our weekly report, we noted that on July 26, an officer stopped a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway and subsequently arrested the driver for an O W I.

The flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and the restaurant is open until 10 PM. You can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4:30 PM and at the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
